evidence.title: Discord API Reference
evidence.quote:
Authenticating with the Discord API can be done in one of three ways:

1. Using a bot token found on the Bot page within your app's settings.
2. Using an OAuth2 bearer token gained through the OAuth2 API.
3. Using basic authentication with credentials as the client ID and client secret found on the OAuth2 page of your app's settings in the format `client_id:client_secret` as a Base64 encoded string. Only applicable for OAuth2 API token endpoints.
